name: House Volkov
benefit: Equipment from Volkov's domain up to a Tier above your Wealth Tier. Advantage on rolls to acquire military intel.
obligation: Annual tithe + service obligations. Cannot break sworn oaths.

name: House Kurogane
benefit: Access to cutting-edge tech and augmentations. Advantage on rolls to source or repair advanced equipment.
obligation: Annual tithe + ceremonial appearances. Oppose the heresy of Naturalism.

name: House Solari
equip: Ceremonial items, fine goods, social access tokens
benefit: Starting Reputation +3 with Imperial institutions. Invitations to high-society functions.
obligation: Tithe + public alignment. Attend restoration-themed events.

name: House Valerius
equip: Commercial goods, Pearl-related items, financial instruments
benefit: Advantage on all financial and commercial negotiations. Access to Pearl markets at preferred rates.
obligation: Annual tithe. Work through Valerius commercial channels.

name: House Joric
equip: Defensive equipment, security tech, contract paperwork
benefit: Legal protection in most jurisdictions. Advantage on rolls to obtain security clearances or contracts.
obligation: Annual tithe + contract justification for any violence.

name: House Amaranth
equip: Books, archives, research materials, esoteric instruments
benefit: Access to restricted archives. Advantage on Research rolls drawing on House Amaranth resources.
obligation: Annual tithe. Preserve and share knowledge.

name: Free Fleet
equip: Ship parts, salvage gear, survival kit
benefit: Owed favors across Free Fleet docks. Advantage on rolls to find ships, berths, or crew in any port.
obligation: Dock fees + mutual-aid obligations. Honor signed contracts.

name: Solara Compact
equip: Core-Worlds equipment, ceremonial goods, restoration tools
benefit: Advantage on diplomatic rolls with Imperial-adjacent factions. Access to restoration project resources.
obligation: Political contributions. Attend restoration events. Maintain public alignment.

name: Explorers' Guild
equip: Exploration gear, Veil-route data, survey instruments
benefit: Access to classified Veil-route data. Advantage on rolls to identify unexplored regions or anomalies.
obligation: Quarterly survey reports + mentorship of junior members.

name: Stellar Commerce Guild
equip: Commercial goods, market data, trade credentials
benefit: Recognized as a licensed trader in all major ports. Advantage on rolls to source or sell any commodity.
obligation: Commission on major transactions. Trade through Guild channels.

name: Church of the Eternal Veil
equip: Ritual goods, Mystic instruments, contemplative tools
benefit: Recognized by Veil-sensitive communities. Advantage on rolls involving Mystic sites or sacred substrate.
obligation: Ritual attendance + contemplative practice + tithes of time or substance.

name: Independent
benefit: No dues or obligations. You gain a Standing Pool of 3 points, redeemable once per session as a general social resource.
obligation: None formal — but no formal protection either.

name: House Kaelen
equip: Diplomatic credentials, translation systems, legal archives, nonlethal sidearms, restraint gear, field medical supplies, surveillance countermeasures
benefit: Within a recognized Kaelen charter or mixed-jurisdiction dispute, gain Advantage on a Presence Roll to mediate or a Knowledge Roll to interpret treaty law, jurisdiction, protected status, or formal obligations.
obligation: Accept lawful rotation, preserve public neutrality, document significant political and security information, and protect chartered vulnerable populations.
